title: Migrating to 0.3
summary: Choose the router engine explicitly and upgrade the Preact runtime.

sections.title: Data routers now have an explicit factory
sections.body: In 0.2, createRouter included data handling. In 0.3, replace it with createDataRouter wherever routes use loaders, actions, fetchers or revalidation. Keep createRouter for navigation-only applications. The server and application helpers already choose the data engine.
sections.code:
import { createDataRouter } from "@kasperrt/smolter/react";

const router = createDataRouter(routes, { browser: true });

sections.title: Preact 11
sections.body: Upgrade Preact to 11.0.1 or newer. React and Preact still have separate scoped imports; no React runtime is required for a Preact application.

sections.title: Optional application entry points
sections.body: Keep SSR and Vite imports in server/build files. Preact hydration uses /preact/client; document components use /preact/document. /preact/lazy-route supports lazy file manifests. Ordinary routing uses /preact. See the virtual routes and Express guides for complete entry files.
sections.code:
import { mountApplication } from "@kasperrt/smolter/preact/client";
import { Document } from "@kasperrt/smolter/preact/document";

sections.title: Size and release notes
sections.body: The bundle-size guide reports separate routing, data, transport and application measurements. Do not add overlapping rows. The changelog lists all 0.3.0 changes.
